name: k4_gravity_trick_balloon
purpose: Gravity is up from turn 1 (Metagross). On turn 2 Klefki (Prankster, Sitrus Berry) switches items with Arcanine (Air Balloon) and receives the balloon: setItem runs the balloon's onStart, which prints nothing under Gravity (data/items.ts:191-195), so the Switcheroo's -item lines are the only item lines. Arcanine's own balloon line on turn 1 comes before Gravity (it leads, Gravity is not up yet).
